content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Tacoma

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific thresholds based on your degree level, then gather documentation of your hands-on project work. Eligibility confirmation takes 15–30 minutes and ensures you're ready to proceed.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend all sessions at your own pace, ask questions in real time, and receive course materials and recordings. This formal education is mandatory for PMI application and equips you with the knowledge needed to pass the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, complete the PMP application form, and document your project-management experience as required. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Processing typically takes several business days; you'll receive confirmation and instructions to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a local or online testing center. On exam day, bring required identification and plan for a focused four-hour assessment of project-management competency.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn your PMP credential valid for three years. Throughout the renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved courses, volunteer work, or publications. Complete your recertification before expiration to keep your credential active and demonstrate ongoing mastery of project-management practices.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
